26856-solander-s-radio-tomb.title: Solander S Radio Tomb
26856-solander-s-radio-tomb.creator: Unknown
26856-solander-s-radio-tomb.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Of course, this was what was to be expected of Murchison. And if I did let out a few laps of anger, I feel I was entirely justified. Radio fans are always disputing over the relative merits of crystal and tube sets, but I knew I was right.

51714-the-great-experience.title: The Great Experience
51714-the-great-experience.creator: Unknown
51714-the-great-experience.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. This quaint little city seems to cuddle up to the great Rocky Mountains as if for protection from the outer and larger cities of Utah, where the world has crept in and has somewhat changed the spirit of fifty years ago.

arxiv-1904-12905.title: Dependence of the magnetic interactions in MoS 2 monolayer on Mn-doping configurations
arxiv-1904-12905.creator: Adlen Smiri, Iann C. Gerber, Samir Lounis, Sihem Jaziri
arxiv-1904-12905.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Adlen Smiri, Iann C. Gerber, Samir Lounis, Sihem Jaziri. Understanding the magnetic properties of the various Mn doping configurations that can be encountered in 2 ​ H 2H -MoS 2 monolayer could be beneficial for its use in spintronics. Using density functional theory plus Hubbard term (DFT + + U) approach, we study how a single isolated, double- and triple-substitution configurations of Mn atoms within a MoS 2 monolayer could contribute to its total magnetization.

arxiv-2010-05025.title: Historical Credibility for Movie Reviews and Its Application to Weakly Supervised Classification
arxiv-2010-05025.description: Abstract In this study, we deal with the problem of judging the credibility of movie reviews. The problem is challenging because even experts cannot clearly and efficiently judge the credibility of a movie review and the number of movie reviews is very large.

arxiv-2108-10357.title: End-to-End Open Vocabulary Keyword Search
arxiv-2108-10357.creator: Bolaji Yusuf, Alican Gok, Batuhan Gundogdu, Murat Saraclar
arxiv-2108-10357.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bolaji Yusuf, Alican Gok, Batuhan Gundogdu, Murat Saraclar. Recently, neural approaches to spoken content retrieval have become popular. However, they tend to be restricted in their vocabulary or in their ability to deal with imbalanced test settings. These restrictions limit their applicability in keyword search, where the set of queries is not known beforehand, and where the system should return not just whether an utterance contains a query but the exact location of any such occurrences.

arxiv-2108-13446.title: Benchmarking the Accuracy and Robustness of Feedback Alignment Algorithms
arxiv-2108-13446.creator: Albert Jiménez Sanfiz, Mohamed Akrout
arxiv-2108-13446.description: Abstract Backpropagation is the default algorithm for training deep neural networks due to its simplicity, efficiency and high convergence rate. However, its requirements make it impossible to be implemented in a human brain. In recent years, more biologically plausible learning methods have been proposed.

arxiv-2109-13832.title: Compositional Construction of Abstractions for Infinite Networks of Switched Systems
arxiv-2109-13832.creator: Maryam Sharifi, Abdalla Swikir, Navid Noroozi, Majid Zamani
arxiv-2109-13832.description: Abstract We construct compositional continuous approximations for an interconnection of infinitely many discrete-time switched systems. An approximation (known as abstraction) is itself a continuous-space system, which can be used as a replacement of the original (known as concrete) system in a controller design process.

arxiv-2301-06876.title: CS-lol: a Dataset of Viewer Comment with Scene in E-sports Live-streaming Conference: ACM SIGIR Conference on Human Information Interaction and Retrieval; March 19–23, 2023; Austin, TX, USA ACM SIGIR Conference on Human Information Interaction and Retrieval (CHIIR ’23), March 19–23, 2023, Austin, TX
arxiv-2301-06876.creator: Junjie H. Xu, Yu Nakano, Lingrong Kong, Kojiro Iizuka
arxiv-2301-06876.description: Abstract . Billions of live-streaming viewers share their opinions on scenes they are watching in real-time and interact with the event, commentators as well as other viewers via text comments. Thus, there is necessary to explore viewers’ comments with scenes in E-sport live-streaming events.

arxiv-2307-04652.title: Winding number and circular 4-coloring of signed graphs
arxiv-2307-04652.creator: Anna Gujgiczer, Reza Naserasr, Rohini S, S Taruni
arxiv-2307-04652.description: Abstract Concerning the recent notion of circular chromatic number of signed graphs, for each given integer k k we introduce two signed bipartite graphs, each on 2 ​ k 2 − k + 1 2k^{2}-k+1 vertices, having shortest negative cycle of length 2 ​ k 2k , and the circular chromatic number 4.

arxiv-2412-05382.title: Scalar perturbation and density contrast evolution in f ⁡ ( Q , C ) f(Q,C) gravity
arxiv-2412-05382.creator: Ganesh Subramaniam, Avik De, Tee-How Loo, and Yong Kheng Goh
arxiv-2412-05382.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ganesh Subramaniam, Avik De, Tee-How Loo, and Yong Kheng Goh. The symmetric teleparallel theory offers an alternative gravitational formulation which can elucidate events in the early and late universe without requiring the physical existence of dark matter or dark energy. In this formalism, f ⁡ ( Q , C ) f(Q,C) gravity has been recently introduced by incorporating the boundary term C C with the non-metricity scalar Q Q .

arxiv-2502-19635.title: Developing robust methods to handle missing data in real-world applications effectively Thanks: This work was presented at the ECML PKDD 2024 PhD Forum. https://ecmlpkdd.org/2024/program-accepted-phd-forum/ Affiliation: School of Information Technology, Deakin University, Geelong, Victoria, Australi
arxiv-2502-19635.creator: Youran Zhou, Mohamed Reda Bouadjenek, Sunil Aryal
arxiv-2502-19635.description: Abstract Missing data is a pervasive challenge spanning diverse data types, including tabular, sensor data, time-series, images and so on. Its origins are multifaceted, resulting in various missing mechanisms. Prior research in this field has predominantly revolved around the assumption of the Missing Completely At Random (MCAR) mechanism.

pmc-10710111.title: Predictive power of isolated high home systolic blood pressure for cardiovascular outcomes in individuals with type 2 diabetes mellitus: KAMOGAWA-HBP study
pmc-10710111.creator: Yukako Hosomi, Emi Ushigome, Nobuko Kitagawa, Noriyuki Kitagawa, Toru Tanaka, Goji Hasegawa, Masayoshi Ohnishi, Sei Tsunoda, Hidetaka Ushigome, Naoto Nakamura, Mai Asano, Masahide Hamaguchi, Masahiro Yamazaki, Michiaki Fukui
pmc-10710111.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Aims/IntroductionIsolated high home systolic blood pressure (IHHSBP) is a risk for cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, no study has shown an association between IHHSBP and CVD in diabetes. We examined the association between IHHSBP and CVD in type 2 diabetes.Materials and MethodsThis retrospective cohort study included 1082 individuals with type 2 diabetes, aged 20 to 90 years, without a history of macrovascular complications. Home blood pressure (HBP) was measured three times every morning and evening for 14 days.

pmc-11355373.title: The Trends in Atrial Fibrillation-Related Mortality before, during, and after the COVID-19 Pandemic Peak in the United States
pmc-11355373.creator: Inon Dimri, Ariel Roguin, Nashed Hamuda, Rami Abu Fanne, Maguli Barel, Eran Leshem, Ofer Kobo, Gilad Margolis, Giovanni Di Salvo
pmc-11355373.description: Background: During the first months of the COVID-19 outbreak, an increase was observed in atrial fibrillation (AF)-related mortality in the United States (U.S). We aimed to investigate AF-related mortality trends in the U.S. before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic peak, stratified by sociodemographic factors.

pmc-11671242.title: Olympic distance duathlon and cardiac performance in highly‐trained triathletes
pmc-11671242.creator: J A Donaldson, J D Wiles, M Papadakis, S Sharma, R Sharma, J M O'Driscoll
pmc-11671242.description: The effects of triathlon exercise on cardiac function are well documented. While Olympic triathlon (swim‐bike‐run) remains the standard format, increasing concerns about water quality in natural waterways present ongoing challenges for open‐water swimming events, highlighting the potential need to consider alternative formats such as duathlon (run‐bike‐run) in some circumstances.

pmc-12636914.title: Airway clearance techniques for adults receiving extracorporeal membrane oxygenation for severe acute respiratory failure: a scoping review protocol
pmc-12636914.creator: Tom Lunn, Ema Swingwood, Hannah Cochrane, Steven Walker, Fiona Cramp
pmc-12636914.description: IntroductionPatients receiving extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) for severe acute respiratory failure (SARF) often experience significant challenges with airway clearance due to disease severity, ultra-protective ventilation strategies and suppression of mucociliary and cough mechanisms. Extremely low tidal volumes and minimal flow rates further hinder secretion mobilisation.

pmc-13336989.title: Bioinformatic identification of genes and mechanisms related to acute respiratory distress syndrome and sepsis: A bioinformatic study
pmc-13336989.creator: Rui Zhang, Yinghua Fu, Fang Long, Qiong Cheng
pmc-13336989.description: We hypothesized that acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) and sepsis share hypoxia-related transcriptional signatures that reflect overlapping immunopathogenic mechanisms. This study aimed to identify shared hypoxia-related genes and associated regulatory features using bioinformatic analyses. Gene expression datasets GSE28750 and GSE76293 were analyzed separately after within-dataset normalization.

pmc-13515067.title: Oral Health and Oral Health-Related Quality of Life in Patients Undergoing Inpatient Treatment for Heroin-Related Opioid Use Disorder
pmc-13515067.creator: Nina Dimitrijevic Jovanovic, Maja Milosevic Markovic, Jovana Kuzmanovic-Pficer, Vesna Bjegovic-Mikanovic, Srdjan Milovanovic, Ivan Dozic, Sanja Medenica, Natasa Pejcic, Neda Perunovic, Dejan Calasan, Milica Jaksic Karisik, Svetlana Jovanovic

pmc-13560917.title: State of nutrient management infrastructure of lagoons wastewater systems serving small communities in the U.S
pmc-13560917.creator: Denis Ruto, Ziya Jang, Pablo K Cornejo, Harold Leverenz, Kevin Orner
pmc-13560917.description: Lagoon wastewater treatment systems remain the backbone of sanitation in many small U.S. communities, yet their treatment technologies and nutrient management performance remain poorly characterized. Using publicly available federal and state datasets supplemented by permit reviews, this study evaluated the existing nutrient management infrastructure for municipal lagoon wastewater systems serving communities with less than 10 000 residents.

pmc-13677585.title: Randomized Clinical Trial of Ringer’s Lactate Versus Chloride-Reduced Saline-Dextrose in Postoperative Kidney Transplantation
pmc-13677585.creator: Kornrawee Sawasdichai, Chanyanuch Rakpithayanon, Sirihatai Konwai, Thunyatorn Wuttiputhanun, Nuttha Lumlertgul, Kirada Apisutimaitri, Rattanaporn Burimsittichai, Athaya Vorasittha, Pea Pobpan, Adis Tasanarong, Asada Leelahavanichkul, Natavudh Townamchai, Kearkiat Praditpornsilpa, Somchai Eiam-Ong, Y
pmc-13677585.description: IntroductionNormal saline administration induces hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis, potentially impairing kidney allograft recovery. The comparative efficacy of balanced crystalloids against actively chloride-reduced saline protocols remains unclear.MethodsThis randomized, open-label trial compared Ringer’s Lactate Solution (RLS) with a dynamic dual-infusion protocol of normal saline and 5% dextrose (NSS + D5W) in adult kidney transplant recipients.
